# sofascore_scraper.store.ApplyResult
# kaynak: sofascore_scraper/store/follows.py
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ApplyResult:
    origin: str
    added: Tuple[Follow, ...] = ()
    updated: Tuple[Follow, ...] = ()
    removed: Tuple[Follow, ...] = ()
    unchanged: int = 0
    conflicts: Tuple[FollowConflict, ...] = ()
    @property
    def changed(self) -> bool
